units.text: Table 1. Lifespan (years) , queen number and mode of colony founding in ants. M: species that are primarily monogynous. P: species that are primarily polygynous. I: species that found new colonies primarily through independent colony founding; D : species that generally use a dependent colony founding; Pa: species that parasitize colonies of other ant species. Species that commonly have both monogyne and polygyne colonies are referred as M, P. Similarly, species that found new colonies independently and dependently are referred as I, D
